pr_title: [Performance] [Ops][Feature] Parallelize spec_decode input copy kernel across batch dimension
source_quote:
![high]
By changing the grid from `[1,]` to `[batch_size,]`, the kernel launch will crash if `batch_size` is `0` (since a grid dimension of `0` is invalid in Triton/CUDA). In the original implementation, a `batch_size` of `0` was safe because the grid was `[1,]` and the internal loop `range(0, batch_size)` simply did not execute.
> To prevent runtime crashes when `batch_size` is `0`, we should guard the kernel launch with `if batch_size > 0:`.

correspondence.patch_snippet: 评后sha f6d0bee 体现修改

rule.description: 当将 Triton kernel 的 grid 从固定值 `[1,]` 改为动态值 `[batch_size,]` 以并行化时，必须用 `if batch_size > 0:` 守卫 kernel launch。`batch_size=0` 时 grid 维度为 0，在 Triton/CUDA/NPU 中是无效的（`coreDim=0 is invalid`），会导致运行时崩溃。原实现 grid 为 `[1,]` 时，内部循环 `range(0, batch_size)` 在 `batch_size=0` 时自然不执行，不会崩溃；改为动态 grid 后这个隐式安全行为丢失，必须显式守卫。
checkpoints: 识别 Triton kernel 的 grid 配置是否包含动态维度（如 `[batch_size,]`、`[num_tokens,]`）
确认该动态维度是否可能为 0（空 batch、空 prompt、dummy run 等场景）
在 kernel launch 前加 `if batch_size > 0:` 或类似条件守卫
验证 batch_size=0 时是否正确跳过 kernel launch 而非崩溃
